title: Luoyang module port (LY-006 v1; extends LY-005-port-v1)
description: Same fields and invariants as LY-005 port-schema.json (local + world, column-major node matrix, measuredFrom with SHA256). LY-006 adds four kinds, producer/steward/consumers, and allows world=null only while the local frame has no placement (frames listed in registry/zones.json).

producer.description: seat that measured/built it (LY-005 / LY-006 for ports on existing geometry)

steward.description: seat that may bump the version; a bump needs every consumer to re-ack

measuredFrom.description: file path(s) + sha256 + method; must allow recomputation

x-invariants: all LY-005 x-invariants (world = N*local, residual <= 1e-6 m; forward/up rotate with N; N equals the frame placement or city-data node matrix)
world == null only if registry frame placement == null; it must be filled in the same version once a placement is frozen by LY-010/LY-100 (that is a new version if the value changes)
both sides of a seam reference the same portId and version (registry/seams.json)
kinds mount/opening carry hinge axes or opening state; cut carries the boundary of a ground/wall opening; drain carries an outlet with downhill forward
